title: UV (whitener/laundry detergent) Invisible Ink [Spy & Detective Science]
description:
We show you how to use science to become a spy or a detective 
Use science to make invisible ink at home using whitener/laundry detergent and a UV/blacklight
Use science, STEM, STEAM to engage kids who love spy and detective science books like Nancy Drew and Sherlock Holmes
